description: A version-1 RELAY_OFFER record that breaks one rule of RAVEN_ROUTE_HINTS_V1 §11.2: decode_offer refuses it as malformed. In an RRH1 frame (frame_hex: the sender seed's P2P_ID, then this record as entry type 0x20) the record is dropped with an RRH1_MALFORMED debug log and the frame is kept

expected.reason: an address goes on past its transport (/p2p/<PeerId>): host and transport only

name: RELAY_OFFER address with a /p2p suffix
